NOTE
**Still not ready — the screenshots still can't be compared before and after**

New: The author added a section on how this PR relates to #33086 and added support for a space after `](` with a test. Code changes since the feedback couldn't be checked. Missing: Matching before/after screenshots. There are still 4 unlabeled "before" images against 2 "after" images, and no side-by-side pairs for the same cases.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready"; laurynmm already gave the feedback, so no new assignment is needed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the comparison with #33086. The screenshots still need work: please show the same cases side by side, with one labeled "before" and one labeled "after" for each, as described in [the guide on precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
